target_customer: AI labs, startups and GPU owners that need to buy, sell or hedge H100 capacity for specific weeks
problem: GPU capacity mostly trades in private chats and on opaque pricing pages, so buyers cannot lock dated capacity or hedge price swings.
business_model: exchange take rate on physical GPU capacity and derivatives, plus Backchannel AI deal-matching product

competitors.name: Ornn
competitors.what: Compute futures exchange with a Compute Price Index, ICE planning contracts on it
competitors.traction_then: ICE announced futures plans in May 2026, subject to regulatory approval
competitors.funding_then: Reported seed rounds of 5.7M USD in late 2025 and 33M USD led by a16z in June 2026 (outlets differ)

competitors.name: CME Group with Silicon Data
competitors.what: Cash-settled H100 and B200 rental index futures
competitors.traction_then: Planned for October 2026 pending CFTC review

competitors.name: Kalshi
competitors.what: CFTC-regulated GPU rental forward curves for B200, H200 and A100

competitors.name: Architect
competitors.what: Futures exchange adding AI compute contracts
competitors.funding_then: 35M USD raised in December per a news summary

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching engine and pricing are standard fintech work, but settlement of physical GPU nodes and any derivatives status need regulatory and operational depth.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity could become a network effect, but at founding several funded exchanges and CME were already moving on the same idea.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown yet. Large exchanges announced compute futures in 2026.

market_need_then: AI compute spend was exploding and prices volatile, and exchanges and startups all announced compute futures in 2026, which signals demand for hedging.

branding.domain_note: Uses getcomputable.com, a get prefix, not the exact .com

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, concise, action-oriented, for example Your own AI head of compute

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found, and the generic word overlaps with other companies.

outcome_analysis: Computable is an active Summer 2026 company with no coverage found of exit, shutdown or layoffs. It enters a crowded 2026 field of compute futures efforts from Ornn, CME, Kalshi and Architect, so execution on physical dated capacity is its likely wedge. Too early for an outcome.
notes: The YC page lists no founders and says the team came from Jump Trading, Coinbase and Citadel Securities. A directory (precize.in) names two 19 year old founders with a different profile, which conflicts and is unverified, so no founders recorded. Company site says backed by Y Combinator and Robinhood Ventures, no amounts. Funding search found nothing for Computable; similar named results were other companies. Outcome search folded into the news search, nothing found. Competitors are as of mid 2026 batch time.
